content: The glycemic index (GI) and glycemic load (GL) are tools designed to assess the effect of carbohydrate-containing foods on blood glucose levels. Foods with low or high glycemic index values have been studied in the context of diabetes management, although the definitions and individual responses to these foods can vary significantly. A prudent approach to using these metrics involves taking into account an individual’s unique blood glucose response, which may assist in making more effective dietary modifications.
